title: Refund Policy for Billing Errors
summary: Refunds are allowed for duplicate billing, confirmed service failure, and approved enterprise exceptions.
details: Support agents should document evidence and escalate larger exceptions for manager review.

title: Enterprise Refund Exception Note
summary: Enterprise customers may qualify for broader refund exceptions when contractual service levels are missed.
details: Contract-linked exceptions should reference SLA impact and involve finance approval.

title: Travel Reimbursement Summary
summary: Employees should submit approved travel receipts within 15 days for transport, lodging, and meals inside policy limits.
details: Missing receipts require manager confirmation before reimbursement can be processed.

title: Password and MFA Requirements
summary: All users must keep MFA enabled and use the guided password reset flow for account recovery.
details: Support should avoid manual bypasses and escalate unusual reset requests to security operations.

title: Laptop and Equipment Request Process
summary: Replacement laptop requests require business justification, manager approval, and inventory confirmation.
details: Urgent replacement cases should include device failure details and expected working impact.
